<p style="font-size: 1.12rem; line-height: 1.55;">Case studies on content design, course architecture, and program building. Each one is a story about a substantive problem, what I actually did about it, and what changed.</p>

<a href="genetics-course-redesign.html" class="work-card">
  <div class="work-card__meta">Course redesign · Higher education</div>
  <h3 class="work-card__title">Redesigning a failing course</h3>
  <p class="work-card__teaser">A flipped, OER-based rebuild of General Genetics that took the drop/fail/withdraw rate from 39% to under 5% — and held there for three consecutive years.</p>
</a>

<a href="phylogenetics-education-program.html" class="work-card">
  <div class="work-card__meta">Program design &amp; launch · Federally-funded research initiative</div>
  <h3 class="work-card__title">Building an education program from nothing</h3>
  <p class="work-card__teaser">An education and outreach division for a federally-funded phylogenetics initiative — including a researcher-educator workshop model whose results surprised the people who commissioned it.</p>
</a>

<a href="stem-completion-equity-analysis.html" class="work-card">
  <div class="work-card__meta">Data analysis · Public dataset · Higher education</div>
  <h3 class="work-card__title">What national data says about the STEM completion gap</h3>
  <p class="work-card__teaser">A reproducible analysis of U.S. bachelor's degree completion in STEM fields using public IPEDS data — who finishes, who doesn't, where the gap lives by field and sector, and where the data runs out of answers.</p>
</a>

<h2 style="font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #7E7567; margin: 4rem 0 2rem 0; font-weight: 500;">More coming</h2>
